_doc: Chennai OSM layers for scripts/fetch-osm-layers.ts. Water bodies and industrial zones are hand-assembled rings (the original Chennai assembly, kept so the published layers do not shift); areas are shoelace hectares at 13 N. Localities are still fetched by scripts/fetch-localities-osm.ts: Overpass returned 504 on every capture attempt, so its port has no byte-identical proof yet.

rivers._note: Wider than the water-body bbox for upstream reaches; the display clip is tighter, except the Kosasthalaiyar keeps its Ponneri-side approach.

industrial-zones._note: North Chennai only (Ennore, Manali, Ambattur); parcels under 5 ha dropped.
